character: A tall, spare elf woman, ageless face, long and patient. Silver-grey hair cropped short. Ink-stained fingertips. A worn brass coin on a cord at her throat. Level grey eyes, mouth set flat.
wardrobe: A long dark sea-coat covered in pockets, wooden tally sticks in each, sleeves rolled to the elbow, a wax tablet and stylus at her hip.

full.framing: Full body portrait, front view. Standing straight on a ship's deck, writing on a wax tablet.

portrait.framing: Head and shoulders portrait, square crop, filling the frame, facing the viewer.

scene.framing: At a barrel used as a table on a ship's deck, counting coins into small even piles while pirates wait in a line.
